d: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the centenary celebrations of the Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce and Industry (FICCI), urging Indian industry to build global competitiveness and contribute to a self-reliant India over the next two decades. Citing a recent World Bank report, he noted that 50 crore Indians escaped poverty over the past 12 to 13 years due to sound policies and clear intent, contrasting this with earlier historical decades.
